releaseNotes:
The first release of Nova Echo brings Compass chat, voice conversations, and permission-controlled computer actions to your Windows desktop.

## ✨ Features

### Chat and Voice
- Describe tasks in plain language and follow up in the same conversation.
- Talk naturally with spoken replies. Interrupt speech without ending the conversation.
- Access Compass tools available to your account, including web search, knowledge bases, Microsoft 365, and document generation.

### Desktop Assistance
- Share your screen when needed so Nova can understand what you are working on.
- Use mouse, keyboard, and window actions to work with desktop applications.
- Open applications, websites, and local documents. Read and write supported local files within configured allowed folders.
- Use clipboard tools and run local commands with explicit approval.

### Permissions and Activity
- Deny actions, allow them once, or remember supported permissions. Review and revoke saved choices in Settings.
- Allow routine computer actions for one task, while retaining separate confirmation for sensitive operations.
- Follow tool activity and stop running work. Stopping does not undo completed actions.

## 🔄 Updates
- Check for updates at startup or from Settings, review release notes, and choose when to download and install.
- Installation is blocked while tasks or voice conversations are active.

## 🖥️ Compatibility and Setup
- Windows x64. macOS is not included in this release.
- Requires a Compass API key and an internet connection; available models and tools depend on your account.
- The installer bundles the computer-control runtime; no developer tools are required.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/nova)
